# MDD Sim Gateway v1.8.0

## 中文

### 1. v1.8.0 本次版本更新

- 通过 [PR #36](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/36) 支持配置**多个飞书/Lark 机器人**，
  并可按 SIM 线路分流。每个机器人有独立的 Webhook 地址、签名密钥、事件开关、消息模板和测试推送；
  不设线路筛选的机器人接收全部线路和网关事件，设了筛选的只接收匹配线路的事件。投递重试与记录
  按机器人独立，一个机器人不可达不会拖慢另一个。原有的单机器人配置会自动迁移，不会重复发送，
  磁盘上仍保留旧格式以便回滚。
- 通过 [PR #35](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/35) 新增 DITO Telecommunity
  （PLMN 515-66）VoWiFi 支持。该运营商 ePDG 对 MODP-2048 提案集回 NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN，
  只接受 AES-CBC-128 / HMAC-SHA1 / MODP-1024，因此这套旧套件**仅**对该 PLMN 启用，
  其他运营商的四组提案及其顺序完全不变。同时补齐了 DITO 在首次 IKE_AUTH 中发送的
  AT_PERMANENT_ID_REQ 和 AT_FULLAUTH_ID_REQ 身份请求——此前它们被忽略，
  日志却报告 NO EAP PAYLOAD RECEIVED。
- 修复外发短信会产生幽灵收信记录的问题。SMSC 对我们提交的每一段短信都会异步回一条
  RP-ACK（失败时为 RP-ERROR），引擎此前既不识别、又照样把它交给 dialplan，
  而它不含 TPDU，于是每段都写下一条空白的收信记录——一条六段长短信就留下六条幽灵消息。
  现在报告会被识别、应答，并在进入 dialplan 前终止；拒绝原因会带 RP cause 记录下来。
- 修复长短信迟到分段被当作新消息的问题。跨运营商实测中，同一条六段短信的第 1 段与
  第 2 段相隔十分钟到达，远超原有 180 秒的拼包窗口，导致同一条短信在会话里出现两条
  互相残缺的记录。现在残缺落库的分组会保留一小时，迟到的分段直接补回原消息的空缺处。
- 修复浏览器通话可能接通即静音的隐患。WebRTC 端点声称支持 opus，但引擎镜像从未包含
  codec_opus——它是 Digium 仅发布 x86 版的外部二进制模块，在 arm64 上启用它是静默无效的。
  目前通话能通是因为浏览器同时提供了 ulaw/alaw 作为兜底；一旦对端只提供 opus，
  就会接通后双向无声且日志无任何提示。现在不再声称支持 opus，通话仍走原本实际使用的
  ulaw/alaw。
- 控制面与引擎镜像大幅瘦身：压缩后 194 MB → 76 MB 和 272 MB → 143 MB，
  磁盘占用 852 MB → 355 MB 和 1.04 GB → 607 MB。控制面不再把构建工具链打进成品镜像，
  引擎只保留自己真正能加载的 Asterisk 模块并去除调试符号——这同时移除了 109 个
  仅由「已被 noload 却仍在磁盘上」的模块拖入的系统包。
  **安装与升级的空间要求随之下调**：安装前所需可用空间由 4 GiB 降到 2 GiB，升级前预留由
  6 GiB 降到 3 GiB，建议系统盘由 16 GB 降到 8 GB。文档同时给出了实测占用，便于自行核算。
  在设备上手工执行源码构建仍需额外数 GiB，不在此列。

### 2. v1.8 功能概览

- 飞书/Lark 从单个机器人扩展到多个，可按 SIM 线路分流，与其他通道共用事件模板、测试反馈、
  重试和投递记录。
- VoWiFi 通过可配置的 IKE-SA 换钥和更可追溯的自动恢复记录，改善长时间运行的稳定性。
- 候选版管理、明确的通知/更新出口和更完整的代理诊断，让测试、回退和故障定位都可在 WebUI 完成。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。引擎侧改动包含 Asterisk 补丁，
自动更新会按指纹判定为需要全量重建。

---

## English

### 1. v1.8.0 release changes

- [PR #36](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/36) lets Feishu/Lark notifications fan
  out to **several independently configured bots**, each routed to the SIM lines you choose. A bot
  carries its own webhook, signing secret, event switches, templates and test action; one with no
  line filter receives everything, which is what the single bot did, and one with a filter receives
  only its lines. Retries and delivery history are per bot, so an unreachable bot no longer holds
  another up through the retry ladder. An existing single-bot configuration migrates by itself
  without sending anything twice, and the old shape stays on disk so a rollback still reads it.
- [PR #35](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/35) adds DITO Telecommunity
  (PLMN 515-66) VoWiFi support. Its ePDG answers the MODP-2048 proposal set with
  NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN and offers only AES-CBC-128 / HMAC-SHA1 / MODP-1024, so that legacy suite
  is selected for that PLMN **alone** — every other carrier keeps the existing four proposals in
  the same order and with the same transforms. The RFC 4187 identity requests DITO sends during
  the first IKE_AUTH exchange, AT_PERMANENT_ID_REQ and AT_FULLAUTH_ID_REQ, are now answered
  instead of being ignored while the log claimed NO EAP PAYLOAD RECEIVED.
- Sending a message no longer leaves phantom inbound records behind. The SMSC reports on every
  submitted segment asynchronously, as an RP-ACK (or RP-ERROR when it refuses). The engine
  recognised neither and handed them to the dialplan anyway; carrying no TPDU they arrived
  empty, so a six-segment text wrote six bodyless inbound messages. Reports are now recognised,
  answered — an unanswered report is repeated — and stopped before the dialplan, and a refusal
  is logged with its RP cause.
- A late part of a long message now completes the message it belongs to. Parts are buffered for
  180 seconds and the group is then published with its gaps marked; anything arriving afterwards
  used to start a new group and appear as a second, near-duplicate fragment. Measured between
  two carriers, part 1 of a six-part text arrived after 11 seconds and parts 2-6 ten minutes
  later, so this was the normal outcome. A flushed group stays addressable for an hour.
- The WebRTC endpoint no longer offers a codec the image cannot encode. codec_opus is an
  external, x86-only binary module, so `menuselect --enable codec_opus` has always been a
  silent no-op on arm64. Calls work today only because browsers also offer ulaw/alaw; a peer
  that offered opus alone got a connected call with no audio in either direction and nothing in
  the log to explain it. Opus is no longer advertised, and calls continue over the ulaw/alaw
  path they already used.
- The control and engine images are substantially smaller: 194 MB -> 76 MB and 272 MB -> 143 MB
  compressed, 852 MB -> 355 MB and 1.04 GB -> 607 MB on disk. The control image no longer ships
  the toolchain that built it, and the engine ships only the Asterisk modules it can load,
  stripped — which also drops the 109 packages that were pulled in by modules the engine already
  refused to load.
  **The documented storage requirements drop with them**: 4 GiB free before installation becomes
  2 GiB, the 6 GiB kept free for an upgrade becomes 3 GiB, and the recommended system disk goes
  from 16 GB to 8 GB. The measured footprint is documented alongside so the figures can be
  checked. Building the engine from source on the device still needs several GiB more.

### 2. v1.8 at a glance

- Feishu/Lark goes from one bot to as many as you need, each routed to chosen SIM lines, sharing
  the event templates, test feedback, retries and delivery history of every other channel.
- VoWiFi long-run stability improves through a configurable IKE-SA rekey interval and traceable
  automatic recovery records.
- Test-release management, explicit notification/update egress and fuller proxy diagnostics keep
  testing, rollback and fault isolation inside the WebUI.

Both Control and Engine must be updated. The engine change includes an Asterisk patch, so the
fingerprint marks it as a full rebuild.
